detail.longDescription: Salutations, to all in the # fediverse who sees this. My name is Renato. I've been aware of the Fediverse for a long time but have only decided to join in today to connect with those who hold similar interests to mine. My interests include # programming , # cybersecurity , and # sysadmin as I've grown up around all three, having been around a computer since I was 3 years old. I have a few open source projects but I have none of my own contributions at this very moment, which I plan to change by working on # linux , specifically # debian , # gnome and # rust . Aside from computers, I tend to really enjoy the creative works including # writing , # art and # photography myself. I've dabbled a little in # film as well, making some short films while I was in a college course for Media and Journalism. As such, I have a strong distaste on creative works made with generative AI, and resist using it where ever I can. This also includes programming and technical write-ups. I hope to enjoy my time on the Fediverse! 😄 # introduction
